verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents a public REST API with an endpoint reference (e.g., Create merchant, Update merchant), long-lived server API keys, and an OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification. The API is offered as a first-class option for payins and merchant onboarding, alongside webhooks, a full sandbox and an llms.txt index of machine-readable docs, so it can be driven programmatically. Missing for 10: the OpenAPI spec could not be found at standard discoverable paths (probe returned 404s), direct-API onboarding of sensitive data requires Rainforest approval, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
